words.sentence1: A gentle zephyr rustled through the autumn leaves. (A gentle zephyr rustled through the autumn leaves.)
words.sentence2: She felt a cool zephyr on her face as she walked in the garden. (She felt a cool zephyr on her face as she walked in the garden.)

words.meaning: A light fog or mist, especially one coming from the sea.
words.sentence1: La neblina cubria las montañas al amanecer. (The mist covered the mountains at dawn.)
words.sentence2: Con tanta neblina es difícil ver el camino. (With so much fog it is hard to see the road.)

words.meaning: Light rain consisting of tiny drops.
words.sentence1: Une fine bruine tombe sur la ville ce matin. (A fine drizzle is falling on the city this morning.)
words.sentence2: Il aime marcher sous la bruine printanière. (He likes walking in the spring drizzle.)

words.meaning: The red glow of the morning sky before sunrise.
words.sentence1: Das prächtige Morgenrot kündigte einen schönen Tag an. (The magnificent morning red announced a fine day.)
words.sentence2: Wir bewunderten das Morgenrot über den Bergen. (We admired the morning glow over the mountains.)

words.meaning: Immersing oneself in nature by quietly walking through a forest.
words.sentence1: 週末に森林浴をしてリフレッシュしました。 (I went shinrin-yoku on the weekend and refreshed myself.)
words.sentence2: 森林浴は心身の健康にとても良いです。 (Shinrin-yoku is very good for physical and mental health.)

words.meaning: Dew, moisture condensed from the air onto cool surfaces.
words.sentence1: L'erba era coperta di rugiada fresca. (The grass was covered with fresh dew.)
words.sentence2: Le gocce di rugiada brillavano al sole del mattino. (The dew drops shone in the morning sun.)

words.sentence1: Chunxiao de niao ming zhen shi yingting. (The bird songs of the spring morning are truly pleasant to hear.)
words.sentence2: Zai zhege meihao de chunxiao, women qu paishan le. (On this beautiful spring morning, we went mountain climbing.)

words.meaning: Deep green foliage of summer trees.
words.sentence1: San-eul deop-eun nok-eum-iyeuro gamtan-i jeolro nanda. (One cannot help but admire the deep green foliage covering the mountain.)
words.sentence2: 여름 산의 녹음이 아주 싱그럽다. (Yeoreum san-ui nok-eum-i aju singgeureopda: The green foliage of the summer mountain is very fresh.)

words.sentence1: Pka nis rik ban l'or nas. (This flower blooms very beautifully.)
words.sentence2: Ko-mun ban ch'hkeanh pka ch'hvar. (Grandmother picked some jasmine flowers.)

words.sentence1: Die donderweer het gisteraand reg deur die nag aangehou. (The thunder continued right through the night last night.)
words.sentence2: Ons kon die donderweer in die verte hoor dreun. (We could hear the thunder rumble in the distance.)
